title: Ham and cheese sandwich
transcript:
[PLACEHOLDER NARRATION — replace with the real chef transcript]
Today we're making a simple ham and cheese sandwich, and I'll show you exactly what it should look like at every step. First, lay two slices of bread side by side on the board, flat, not overlapping. Next, take the spread and cover one slice in a thin, even layer. Go all the way to the crust on every side. You spread it right to the edges so every bite has flavour and the filling has something to stick to; bare corners are the first thing people leave behind. Now lay one lettuce leaf flat on the spread side. Tear it if it's too big, so it covers the slice without hanging over. Then the fillings: ham first, then cheese, in one even layer that reaches the edges of the bread. Don't pile it all up in the middle. That's the most common mistake, and it makes the sandwich fat in the centre and empty at the corners, so it falls apart when you cut it. Close the sandwich with the second slice, spread side down, and line the edges up with the bottom slice before you press gently. Finally, cut it once, corner to corner, with one clean stroke. Two even triangles, and you're done.

steps.title: Lay out bread
steps.key_line: Two slices side by side, flat
steps.instruction: Lay two slices of bread side by side on the board, flat, not overlapping.
steps.chef_quote: Lay two slices of bread side by side on the board, flat, not overlapping.
success_criteria: Two slices of bread lie flat on the board
The slices sit side by side without overlapping

watch_fors.mistake: One slice lies partly on top of the other
watch_fors.headline: Slices overlap
watch_fors.spoken: The slices are overlapping — lay them side by side so you can spread one.

steps.title: Spread
steps.key_line: Thin layer, right to every edge
steps.instruction: Cover one slice with the spread in a thin, even layer, all the way to the crust on every side.
steps.chef_quote: Go all the way to the crust on every side.
success_criteria: Spread covers one whole slice in a thin, even layer
Spread reaches the crust on all four sides, with no bare corners

watch_fors.mistake: Spread covers only the middle, leaving bare bread along the edges or corners
watch_fors.headline: Edges left bare
watch_fors.spoken: There's bare bread at the edges — take the spread right to the crust all the way round.

steps.title: Add lettuce
steps.instruction: Lay one lettuce leaf flat on the spread side, tearing it if needed so it covers the slice without hanging over.
steps.chef_quote: Tear it if it's too big, so it covers the slice without hanging over.
success_criteria: A lettuce leaf lies flat on the spread slice
The lettuce stays within the edges of the bread

steps.title: Add fillings
steps.key_line: One even layer, edge to edge
steps.instruction: Lay the ham, then the cheese, in one even layer that reaches the edges of the bread.
steps.chef_quote: Don't pile it all up in the middle.
success_criteria: Ham and cheese cover the slice in one even layer, reaching the edges
No bare bread or lettuce shows around the edge of the filling

watch_fors.mistake: Filling is piled in the middle, bare bread around it
watch_fors.headline: Filling piled up
watch_fors.spoken: The filling is all in the middle — spread it out so it reaches the edges of the bread.

steps.title: Close
steps.key_line: Spread side down, edges lined up
steps.instruction: Close the sandwich with the second slice, spread side down, and line its edges up with the bottom slice before pressing gently.
steps.chef_quote: Line the edges up with the bottom slice before you press gently.
success_criteria: The top slice covers the bottom slice completely
The edges of the two slices line up

watch_fors.mistake: The top slice is shifted, leaving part of the filling uncovered
watch_fors.headline: Slices not lined up
watch_fors.spoken: The top slice has slipped — line its edges up with the bottom slice.

steps.title: Cut
steps.key_line: Corner to corner, one clean cut
steps.instruction: Cut the sandwich once, corner to corner, with one clean stroke.
steps.chef_quote: Two even triangles, and you're done.
success_criteria: The sandwich is cut into two triangles of similar size
The cut runs from one corner to the opposite corner
